description: The baseline leaves Blackwell tensor cores 100% idle (all GEMV/SIMT). Route the O(n^3) work onto them: build a batched BLOCK-JACOBI symmetric eigensolver in Triton whose block rotations and A-updates are TF32/BF16 tl.dot GEMMs, run a small FIXED sweep count (start 3-5, no data-dependent stopping), keeping Q orthogonal by construction as the product of rotations. Finish with one FP32 Newton-Schulz/Gram-Schmidt reorthonormalization of Q and L via the FP32 Rayleigh quotient diag(Q^T A Q). Exploit the loose ~1-2-digit gates. Start on the dominant n=512 batch=640 group, then extend to n=1024/2048.
